title: Request for Oral Presentation (ROP) - Prototype Research, Integration, and Systems Modernization (PRISM)
agency: DEPT OF DEFENSE > DEPT OF THE AIR FORCE > AIR FORCE MATERIEL COMMAND > AIR FORCE TEST CENTER > FA9101  AEDC PKP   PROCRMNT BR
description:
The 704th Test Group (704TG) invites the universities to provide an oral presentation on its proposed management and administrative framework for the 10-year Prototype Research, Integration, and Systems Modernization (PRISM) Master Other Transaction Agreement (OTA). 

 Under 10 U.S.C. § 4022, a prototype project can encompass a novel business practice, process, or administrative methodology. This ROP serves as the formal proposal mechanism for the nocost business process prototype that is the Base OTA itself. The goal is to establish a shared understanding of the operational and administrative workflows that will govern all future funded Project-Level Agreements (PLAs) under this master vehicle. 

 See attachments for more information.
